answer: Edge-Disjoint Path Witnessing. Each agent must route a challenge through agents whose local graphs are edge-disjoint beyond a small meadow of shared peers. Validators accept a response only if the reachable set spans a karst-like sparse cut rather than one dense cluster. A sybil cluster shares edges, so its responses collapse to one signature. Each additional identity costs the attacker a genuinely distinct neighborhood, like a lotus needing separate roots.
